subject: religious-studies

items.q: Is Islam a race or ethnicity?
items.correct: No — it is a religion; Muslims come from many ethnic backgrounds worldwide.
items.random_wrong: Islam is only practised in one country.
items.why: Muslims are a globally diverse community united by faith, not ethnicity.

items.correct: God (Allah) alone; Muhammad is revered as the final prophet, not worshipped.
items.why: Islam is strictly monotheistic (Tawhid); prophets are messengers, not divine.

items.correct: 'Struggle' — the 'greater jihad' is the inner struggle to live well; armed struggle has strict conditions.
items.why: Jihad's primary meaning is personal striving; military jihad is tightly limited in Islamic teaching.
